agents.name: Coordinator
agents.description: Clarifies the question and assigns work to the team.

tools.name: prepare_request
tools.description: Summarizes the topic and intended audience.

agents.system_prompt: Read the user's question and prepare a short, clear request for the other agents.

last_input.question: Explain the water cycle to a 10-year-old.

agents.name: Researcher
agents.description: Collects the facts needed to answer the question.

tools.name: find_sources
tools.description: Finds basic information about the topic.

agents.system_prompt: Gather a few clear facts about the topic without writing the final answer yet.

notes: The sun warms water and some of it evaporates.
Water vapor cools and forms clouds.
Water falls back to Earth as rain or snow.

agents.name: Reviewer
agents.description: Checks that the research notes are clear and consistent.
agents.system_prompt: Review the notes and flag any mistakes or steps that are hard to understand.

last_output.suggestion: Use simple words and explain that the cycle starts again.

agents.name: Writer
agents.description: Turns the research and review into an easy-to-read answer.

tools.name: write_answer
tools.description: Organizes the notes into a short explanation.

agents.system_prompt: Write a short answer for the intended audience using the research notes and review feedback.

notes: Water returns as rain or snow.
last_input.review: Use simple words and explain that the cycle starts again.

last_output.answer: The sun warms water, and some of it rises into the air as vapor. The vapor forms clouds. Then the water falls as rain or snow, and the cycle starts again.
